summary: Deploy Docker applications using templates and a web interface. The upstream project describes this as alpha software; the coverage shows a historical version.
overview: Yacht focuses on making container deployment approachable through reusable templates and a web interface. Templates provide a starting configuration for an application, while the management interface gives you controls for the resulting containers. It is useful for understanding a template-based approach to Docker administration, with the historical coverage and upstream alpha status important context when evaluating it for an installation.
